# Significance retained within the margin

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Retaining and adding significance are a preorder and an excess on admission; under the continuation condition, inclusion and exceeding from every standpoint. A part loses a significant continuation exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin, and adds one exactly where its net exchange admits it.

`significance-retained-within-margin` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

From standpoint p, a level path l retains what has significance along l' (Web.Retains) when l admits every continuation with significance from p that l' admits; it adds (Web.Adds) when l admits a continuation with significance from p that l' does not. Retaining is a preorder (Retains.refl, Retains.trans), and a path that retains another is not added to by it, so it ends none of what has significance there (Retains.not_added); inclusion always retains (Includes.retains) and adding always exceeds (Adds.exceeds). Under the continuation condition (Unrestricted), retaining is inclusion and adding is exceeding (retains_iff_includes, adds_iff_exceeds), alike from every standpoint (retains_agree). In a balanced flow, let l be the levels with a part withheld (WithheldLevels): the levels with the part retain what has significance without it exactly when, for every continuation with significance that l admits and every condition it requires, its need plus what the part has taken so far is at most l plus what the part has given (Flow.Balances.retains_iff_within_margin); the part loses a continuation with significance exactly where l admits it and the part's net draw on some condition it requires exceeds the margin (Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin); it adds one exactly where l does not admit it and, with the part's net exchange, its need is met within the margin (Flow.Balances.adds_iff_within_margin). Under the continuation condition the conveyor's part is unordered: each path adds what the other lacks, and neither retains the other (Transfer.unordered); the giver's part retains and adds (Restoring.Inflow.retains_adds). In Preemption a drawer takes the condition's only unit at step zero, before any dependence forms: the flow balances, only active formations give and take, activity needs support, and its event is active and not undermining; the formation false depends on the condition at need one from step one on, and is admitted at every step without the part and supported at no step from step one with it; the levels without the part include the levels with it, and under the continuation condition the part loses a continuation with significance, so the levels with it do not retain what has significance without it (Preemption.not_undermining_yet_loses). No premise beyond those stated and no Lean axiom is used. Each of the three boundaries has a local form, with balance only at the conditions the continuations compared require, across the steps before each: retaining and losing only at the continuations with significance that the levels without the part admit, adding only at those they do not admit (Flow.retains_iff_within_margin_at, Flow.loses_iff_beyond_margin_at, Flow.adds_iff_within_margin_at); the originals are re-proved in place as corollaries, names and statements unchanged. Under the continuation condition, widening (Web.Widens, see four-cases-of-a-part) is retaining and adding what has significance, keeping the same is retaining both ways, and being mixed is adding both ways (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds, Web.keeps_iff_retains, Web.mixed_iff_adds): the reduction to possibilities loses nothing. The stepwise classes read this order in one direction. Levels below a need are exceeded by every level path admitting the formation there (Web.exceeded_of_below); so an undermining event, through dependences on its condition holding across the step at no smaller need, leaves the levels exceeded by every path meeting those dependences after the step (Web.UnderminingOn.exceeded), a path the levels include admits no such undermining (Web.Includes.not_undermining), and from a standpoint at which those continuations have significance nothing is retained along it (Web.UnderminingOn.not_retains; under the continuation condition from every standpoint, Web.UnderminingOn.not_retains_unrestricted). The converse fails: in Preemption the drawer's event is within renewal and not undermining, and the levels with its part do not include those without it (Preemption.within_renewal_yet_loses).

Canonical source: [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The axiom: Unrestricted sig, that from every standpoint the continuation of anything has significance at every step (boundary neutrality over the index (p, t, f)). It is a hypothesis of the theorems and is not proved; reading it as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation.
- Balance (Flow.Balances); the levels with the part withheld exist (WithheldLevels, given by each witness).
- What is compared is the formations admitted, step by step; renewal capacity and richness of relations are not compared.
- Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; a part is a decided family (part : F → Bool).

Ren's axiom is “for anything, its continuation into the future has significance(doesn't have to be positive, we could argue as long as not harm), or continuation into the future needs to create more significance(being generative)”. Ren also wrote that a center and its boundary exist only within cognitive structure and dynamics, “so there isn't really who's continuation matters, which requires axiom”, and that “not harm” is “a phase transition with a clear boundary”. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): the formation index reads “anything”, a formation's continuation at a step reads “its continuation into the future”, and the standpoint index reads “has significance” unqualified, with no center privileged; retaining reads “as long as not harm”, and adding reads “create more significance”. The names (Unrestricted, Retains, Adds, Preemption and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 37 theorems of Becoming.Significance all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The axiom Unrestricted is a hypothesis of the theorems, not a Lean axiom. The author's counterreview is in §53 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

Only formations admitted are compared, step by step; withholding a part leaves the rest of the exchange as it was; significance is not graded, so a mixed part is unordered; the level at which formations are individuated (members or lineages) fixes what counts as a loss and is given by the representation here; in Preemption the later need is a choice of representation, showing that the two readings differ, not that preemption loses something in every model; decided on Ren's delegation, G0 uses no reading of living; the readings and names are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation.

- The two readings of not harm differ: a preempting drawer is active and not undermining, yet closes a formation that needs the condition later (Preemption.not_undermining_yet_loses). [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)
- A mixed part is unordered (Transfer.unordered): ordering it needs a measure, a further premise. [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

## Dependencies and related results

**Output:** A formation is supported exactly when, on every condition it requires, the part's cumulative net draw stays within the margin.

**Output:** The four cases of a part (widening, narrowing, keeping, mixed).

**Input:** They are the four cases of significance.

**Preserved conditions:** The axiom. [Admission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)


**Output:** The axiom.

- Related, not a proved adapter: [becoming-stepwise-reading](becoming-stepwise-reading.md). Preemption shows that living on the stepwise reading (active and not undermining) differs from retaining: the stepwise reading counts only dependences met, retaining also counts what can still form.
